coupling: The thumbnail-size helper introduced in the first commit now passes a bounded pixel count. Its dynamic decoder still checks that count before appending three bytes per pixel, so that commit remains safe. The later performance commit replaces dynamic appends with a fixed DataBuf and updates its guard and completion check to count pixels, while the allocation still interprets the same value as a byte count. The follow-up unsigned-comparison cleanup preserves that pixel guard. Valid thumbnails therefore write three bytes into each one-byte allocation unit only when these commits are composed; a repair must make the producer and the allocation and write bounds use one consistent unit.
